description: Stub agent cold-start: splash → prompt → user submits → spinner → approval modal → settled prompt. Replay is cumulative — each anchor sees everything from the start of the PTY up to its sentinel.

anchors.name: splash visible
anchors.notes: Splash banner alone — no spinner, no modal, no settled prompt yet. Builder returns null and the daemon's outer policy keeps last-known status.

anchors.name: spinner showing
anchors.notes: Spinner cue alone is sufficient to flip into generating.

anchors.name: approval modal
anchors.notes: Sentinel extends past the buttons so the modal extractor has both header + options in scope.
